title: FOR MOST STATES, OFFTAKE IN 2022-23 TILL NOVEMBER WAS ALREADY HIGHER THAN OFFTAKE IN 2019-20
description:
| State | Offtake 2019-20 (in thousand tons) | Offtake 2020-21 (in thousand tons) | Offtake in 2021-22 (in thousand tons) | Offtake 2022-23 (till November) (in thousand tons) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Uttar Pradesh | ~8,959 | 14,795 | >15,694* | 9,496 |
| Bihar | ~5,404 | 8,427 | ~9,187 | 6,367 |
| West Bengal | ~3,919 | 6,380 | ~6,824 | 4,832 |
| Maharashtra | ~4,029 | 6,664 | ~6,487 | 4,149 |
| Madhya Pradesh | ~3,394 | 5,170 | ~5,517 | 3,572 |
| Rajasthan | ~2,843 | 4,639 | ~4,642 | 3,246 |
| Gujarat | ~1,925 | 3,432 | ~3,780 | 2,599 |
| Odisha | ~2,047 | 3,330 | ~3,703 | 2,870 |
| Jharkhand | ~1,679 | 2,771 | ~2,797 | 2,019 |
| Chhattisgarh | ~1,375 | 2,182 | ~2,437 | 1,623 |
| Meghalaya | 176 | 263 | 289 | 197 |

*Note: The value for 'Offtake in 2021-22' is visually estimated as it exceeds the top of the chart axis.*
